title: Buffs & settings

rotation.help:
Automatic rotation follows the pinned simulator and your current
                talents, targets and gear.
rotation.context: The simulator evaluates abilities using your talents, gear and encounter settings.
rotation.resolved: Automatic priorities are resolved by the pinned simulator when the run starts.

profession.label: Profession {number}
profession.rankUnknown: Rank not provided by the import
profession.choose: Choose a profession to enable its bonuses.
profession.conflicts: {count, plural, one {# item needs attention} other {# items need attention}}
profession.conflictHelp: These manual enhancements no longer meet the profession requirements. Review the affected items or return their enhancements to automatic.
profession.useAutomatic: Use automatic enhancements for affected items
profession.connection: Gear configuration stays connected. Choose individual gems and enchants from an item’s row. Automatic choices follow your profession eligibility.

benefits.Engineering: Eligible tinkers and explosives become available in gear and consume settings.
benefits.Jewelcrafting: Up to 3 Dragon’s Eyes in each tested gear combination.
benefits.Blacksmithing: Additional wrist and glove sockets when the required rank is verified.
benefits.Enchanting: Ring enchants become available when requirements are met.
benefits.Alchemy: Profession-specific flask and elixir benefits are handled by the simulator.
benefits.Herbalism: Lifeblood is handled by the simulator.
benefits.Mining: Toughness is handled by the simulator.
benefits.Skinning: Master of Anatomy is handled by the simulator.

buffs.clearConfirm: Clear all raid, personal, party buffs and target debuffs in this draft?

talents.replaces: Changing the preset also replaces its six glyphs.

consumes.help:
Choose a flask or a battle and guardian elixir. Food and potions are
        separate.
consumes.engineerRequired: These imported choices require Engineering. Review them before running.
consumes.petHelp: Pet controls appear for supported classes. Rank 0 disables a scroll.
